strategy.primary: Villainous Choice and voting: The Valeyard makes opponents face each Villainous Choice twice and gives you an extra vote, so the deck runs Villainous Choice sources and real vote cards (Capital Punishment, Plea for Power, Split Decision, Tyrant's Choice, Messenger Jays) and copies the Valeyard to stack the effects.
strategy.secondary: Premium protection, tutors and interaction around a five-mana commander; Doctor Who villain support.

commander_oracle_snapshots.name: The Valeyard
commander_oracle_snapshots.oracle_text:
If an opponent would face a villainous choice, they face that choice an additional time. (They can make the same or different choices.)
While voting, you may vote an additional time.
